name: Wheat bran
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which the greater part of the endosperm has been removed.

name: Processed animal proteins, poultry, protein > 70%
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy poultry slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. The product must be substantially free of feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Cocoa hulls
description: Hulls of cocoa beans (Theobroma cacaoL.) and the byproduct of the dehulling step in the extraction of cocoa butter. Cocoa hulls are different from cocoa husks, which are the empty pods resulting from the removal of the beans. Other name: cocoa shells.

name: Whey permeate
description: Dried byproduct of ultrafiltration of whey, consisting of low-molecular weight compounds, particularly lactose and minerals. It also includes non-protein nitrogen compounds and vitamins.

name: Liquid potato feed
description: Liquid byproduct of potato (Solanum tuberosumL.) processing, consisting of peels and discarded potato pieces.

name: Ferrous chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeCl2. Other names: iron(II) chloride, ferrous chloride.

name: Maize distillers grains and solubles, oil < 6 %, dried
description: Dried byproduct of alcohol (beverages) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of maize grains (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. This product contains less residual oil than regular maize distillers. Other names and alternative spellings: dried distillers grains with solubles, maize DDGS, corn DDGS, maize distillers' grains, maize distiller's grains, corn distillers.

name: Calcium chloride dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound and common form of calcium chloride with the formula CaCl2·2H2O.

name: Fish solubles, condensed, defatted
description: Concentrated fish soluble proteins obtained by enzymatic hydrolysis, filtration, concentration and dehydration of whole fish or filleting waste, containing less than 15% fat (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Fish oil, rockfish
description: Oil extracted from fish of the rockfish family (Sebastesspp.).

name: Copper chloride tribasic
description: Dicopper chloride trihydroxide is the chemical compound with the formula Cu2(OH)3Cl. It is often referred to as tribasic copper chloride (TBCC), copper trihydroxyl chloride or copper hydroxychloride.

name: Processed animal proteins, poultry, protein 60-70%
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy poultry slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. The product must be substantially free of feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Cottonseed meal, oil 5-20%, crude fibre 15-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of partially dehulled cotton seeds (Gossypiumspp.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Cottonseed hulls
description: Hulls of cotton seeds (Gossypiumspp.), a byproduct of the dehulling step in cotton seed processing.

name: Rice bran, oil < 5%, crude fibre > 20%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has been defatted and contains significant amounts of hulls. Other name: defatted rice bran.

name: Sodium sulfate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with formula Na2SO4. Alternative spelling: sodium sulphate (UK).

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 48% protein + oil
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 48% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Sunflower meal, oil < 5%, non dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of whole (non-dehulled) sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Whey powder, acid
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of soft or fresh cheese. Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Sweet potato, dried
description: Dried sweet potato tuber (Ipomea batatas(L.) Lam.).
